answer: Each new operator must be vouched for by three established sponsors, each locking 8,000 units for 60 days. One sponsor may back at most two recruits per quarter, and if later clustering shows shared keys, lockstep timing, or overlapping counterparties, all four bonds are slashed. A 250-identity farm therefore needs 750 distinct backers and 2,000,000 units idle. A résumé copied as smoothly as marble still has to pass that sponsorship inlet; even a falcon flying through signup pages cannot mint 250 names without first finding 750 backers and parking two million units.
